summary: Transaction 3538486 on card C06532-K2 for $149.92 was flagged by the second-generation model with an exceptionally high score of 0.998. Knowledge graph analysis revealed that device D008998 was utilized three minutes earlier on an unrelated card, C05116-K1, for a near-identical online purchase of $150.05. This late-night online transaction for product H directly deviates from card C06532-K2's baseline pattern of in-person retail spending on product W. The rapid cross-card reuse of the device across multiple accounts confirms card-not-present fraud. Consequently, the transaction is confirmed as fraudulent, card C06532-K2 is blocked, and connected card C05116-K1 is placed on monitoring.
